name: persistent-project-thread
title_zh: 压缩后还能接着聊的项目线程，状态一字不丢
tagline_zh: 长聊压缩最怕失忆——它把可见记录、模型上下文、本地MD状态分层存好，压缩后继续聊，项目脉络和可复用能力都还在。
tagline_en: Compaction usually means amnesia. This keeps transcript, context, and MD state separate, so you resume with full.
desc_en: Maintain one long-lived project chat by separating human-visible transcript history, compactable active model context, durable local ROOT/Child MD state, and reusable local capabilities. Use when the user asks to keep one chat per project, save project state before compaction, compress/compact a long chat, continue after compaction, or design a Root Engineering persistent-thread workflow.
why_zh: 把「对话历史」和「模型上下文」拆开管理，压缩只动后者；本地Root/Child状态文件是持久锚点。
why_en: Splits transcript from active context so compaction only trims the latter; durable Root/Child MD files act as anchors, reloaded.
limit_zh: 只适用于单项目长对话的压缩续聊场景；不负责多项目切换、不自动生成状态文件——需按约定手动维护Root/Child结构。
limit_en: Only for single-project long chats needing compaction/resume; no multi-project switching, no auto state files—Root/Child must be manually maintained.
title_en: Project chat that survives compaction with state intact
